parsed.rationale: Three initializers — `Announcement.init(from:)`, `Breakpoint.init(from:)`, and `Talkset.init(from:)` — are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playlist` package, all carrying no restraint markers (is_test=false, is_mock=false, is_sample_app=false, is_codegen=false). Because the bodies are structurally identical, the canonical Swift remedy is to introduce a protocol (e.g., `PlaylistEntryDecodable`) that refines `Decodable` and provides a default `init(from:)` implementation in a protocol extension, eliminating the three redundant hand-written conformances. All three types already live in the same package, so no cross-package dependency changes are required.
